summary: In this concise keynote excerpt, Jeanne Bliss discusses her leadership book I Love You More Than My Dog (subtitle: Five Decisions That Drive Extreme Customer Loyalty in Good Times and Bad) as a blueprint for shaping the kind of company leaders want to create. She frames the book as a practical leadership guide rather than abstract theory, positioning it as a precursor to the Chief Customer Officer role. Bliss emphasizes building a ‘beloved’ company by guiding decisions about how to treat customers and employees, and notes that the book is widely used by leaders and CEOs as a training resource for teams to align around a shared aspirational direction.
title: Becoming a Beloved Company: Jeanne Bliss on I Love You More Than My Dog
